privacy: Aggregate recruitment operations only. Do not store applicant or outreach-contact personal identity data in this file.

emailWave1.interpretation: Email outreach has produced no confirmed applicant yet. Do not treat sent-message volume as recruitment success.

conversionPolicy.applicationEvidence: Count only a valid beta-interest application, not an outreach send, delivery, page visit or community-admin reply.
conversionPolicy.sourceAttribution: Use only controlled non-identifying src codes from beta_recruitment_sources_v1.json.
conversionPolicy.bounceRule: Do not retry a confirmed invalid mailbox without a newly verified official contact address.
conversionPolicy.channelRule: Prefer admin-permission/community sharing and current EPS learner pools over repeated generic cold email.
